title: Tangent cones at points of spt T via (DTC): blow-ups of a minimizing cycle subconverge to a minimizing cone cycle, and the rescaled weights converge vaguely (parent steps 3–5, (F7))
statement: Assume (DTC), the contract proposition DensityAndTangentCones (Simon 7.3.1). Let n, k, ℓ ∈ ℕ with ℓ ≤ k and n ≥ 1. Let U, N ⊆ ℝ^{n+k}, with U open and N an embedded C² (n+ℓ)-dimensional submanifold with (closure N ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅. Let T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) be minimizing in U ∩ N with spt T ⊆ U ∩ N and ∂T = 0 in U (BoundaryVanishes T). Let R be an IMRep of T in U with weight μ := R.measure, let p ∈ spt T, and let λ_j > 0 (j ∈ ℕ) with λ_j → 0. Then there exist a strictly increasing sub : ℕ → ℕ, a current C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^{n+k}) and an IMRep R_C of C in ℝ^{n+k} such that: C is minimizing in ℝ^{n+k}; ∂C = 0; C is a cone (IsConeCurrent C); R_C represents C; and for every continuous compactly supported f : ℝ^{n+k} → ℝ, ∫ f d(ofReal(λ_{sub(j)}^{−n})•μ.map(dilation p λ_{sub(j)})) → ∫ f dR_C.measure as j → ∞.
